title: AI-Driven Digital Twins for Energy-Efficient Telco Networks
summary: Tata Elxsi is testing AI-driven telecom digital twins in simulated environments to identify energy-saving configurations.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: The proposed system synchronizes network information with models that recommend resource and energy adjustments. Current work consists of prototypes and simulated telecom environments. Better efficiency, lower costs, and reduced emissions are intended benefits, without measured savings from a live network.
purpose: Find and validate lower-energy telecom operating configurations.
system: AI-Driven Digital Twins for Energy-Efficient Telco Networks

ratings.reason: The energy digital twin is tested in simulated telecom environments; actual network savings are not reported.

ai_role.statement: The account does not isolate AI’s contribution from the surrounding workflow.

evidence.citation: International Telecommunication Union, AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025). Project-submitted account, current as of June 2025. ITU provides no independent outcome evaluation.
evidence.title: Use Case 3: AI-Driven Digital Twins for Energy-Efficient Telco Networks

produced_by: The account does not establish conditions sufficient to reproduce the benefit.
must_hold: The account does not establish requirements for reproducing the benefit in other settings.

headline: Network digital twins seek lower telecom energy use
claim_basis: Sources: the makers' report. The cited evidence includes no independent source and no finding by a regulator or court.
